author: FilmCow
description:
Oh nooooo... ahhhhhh! Ahhhhhh!!!! I hope you get well soon!

Are you sick, or do you plan on getting sick at some point in the future? Want a card? These are going to be sent out completely randomly, but if you'd like one send your NAME and COMPLETE ADDRESS to:
RainCityLetters@gmail.com

IMPORTANT: You MUST include "Get Well Card" in the title of your email if you want one of these. Any email without "Get Well Card" in the title will not be opened.

I will mail these cards anywhere in the world, but note that if you're outside the U.S. your "complete address" must include your country.

Chat rules:
* No harassment.
* No racism, sexism, homophobia, transphobia, ableism, fatphobia, or other such things.
* No complaining about how late I’m streaming.
* No self-promotion unless given permission.
* No spamming (this includes asking the same question over and over.)
* No gimmick accounts.

You can write to FilmCow at:

FilmCow
PO Box 781790
Orlando, FL 32878
title: GET WELL SOON!
